因宏福苑火災痛失雙親的宏昌閣居民 C 小姐，今到大埔社區中心出席會議。（資料圖片）

能感受到街坊同聲同氣

C 小姐認為，今次會議當對於上次的網上簡報會，能感受到街坊同聲同氣，因此自己非常期待街坊發問的環節，「上次嘅 Zoom（簡報會）你會覺得係好『做媒』，嗰啲問題根本唔係問題嚟，但今次會聽到一啲 critical（批判性）嘅問題」，如火險賠償細節、勘察報告、再次上樓執拾等等，「大家發問完，有啲街坊熱烈咁拍掌，你就知道係有共鳴感，呢啲就係實在嘅感覺」。

不過，C 小姐認為合安在會議上大多內容只是依書直說，對發問仍然避而不答，「其實居民重複問咗好多次相同嘅問題，但佢哋每次都係『你哋要嘅話就向一戶一社工表達』，我哋有用嘅channel（頻道）都用晒，政府唔肯聽我哋講，搵合安，你又係推，咁一戶一社工好慘喎，食晒你哋啲棍」。

她亦認為，合安在會議上的數據可以更透明，如投票時除了業權份數，亦可列明人數、單位數目，讓資料更同步，「既然你都做得嘅時候，不如清清晰晰」。

未出售業權 會後想法無變

C 小姐指，自己目前並未出售業權，會後亦沒有令她改變想法，「我上樓根本唔夠時間搵嘢，我畀人偷咗嘢、父母一件遺物都搵唔到，咁你唔畀我上樓，我點賣呢？我覺得係好無情」。她目前關注政府可否推遲「831」出售業權的大限，讓業主可先開下一次業主大會，並公開居民要求的勘察報告，詳細交代所有樓宇的情況。

76052ab34dac.content:
Apple 即將推出全新 iPad mini。這將是該裝置兩年來的首次更新，預計會是一次重大改動。以下是目前我們所知的關於即將推出的新 iPad mini 的一切消息。

OLED 顯示屏

迄今為止，新 iPad mini 最大的改變將會是顯示屏。根據多方消息來源，iPad mini 8 將配備 OLED 顯示屏。

這將會是 iPad mini 現有 LCD 屏幕的一大躍升。對用戶而言，改用 OLED 意味著更深的黑色、更豐富的色彩，以及更佳的對比度。iPhone X 於 2017 年成為首款採用 OLED 顯示屏的 iPhone，而配備 OLED 的 iPad Pro 則於 2024 年首次亮相。

然而，一個尚未解決的問題是，新 iPad mini 會否採用 ProMotion 顯示屏，提供高達 120Hz 的更新率。根據上週一則尚未經證實的傳聞，新 iPad mini 將不會支援 ProMotion，而是限制在 60Hz。

不過，這則消息尚未得到其他來源證實，所以我仍然抱希望，希望這則爆料並不準確。

全新晶片

於 2024 年 10 月推出的現有 iPad mini 搭載 Apple A17 Pro 晶片。新 iPad mini 預計將配備 A19 Pro 或 A20 Pro 晶片。這將帶來顯著的效能提升，並可能支援 iOS 27 中最先進的 Siri AI 功能。

更佳的防水效能

據《彭博》報導，Apple 已為 iPad mini 測試「重新設計的外殼」，其防水效能與 iPhone 睇齊。

這個防水外殼最終能否成功應用仍是未知之數。不過，這將令 iPad mini 更為耐用。對將其當作電子書閱讀器的用戶而言，這尤其重要，因為像 Kindle 等專屬電子書閱讀器的其中一大賣點正是防水功能。

全新喇叭技術

iPad mini 8 亦可能是 Apple 首部採用全新振動式喇叭系統的裝置。這套振動式喇叭系統將讓 Apple 可以移除喇叭開孔，有助實現裝置防水。

相比之下，iPhone 雖然設有喇叭開孔，但 Apple 透過使用膠圈及黏合劑來達到防水效果。

新 iPad mini 的發佈日期

根據《彭博》的最新報導，Apple 目標最快於今年 10 月推出配備 OLED 的 iPad mini。據稱這將會是「iPad mini 五年來最大規模的改革」。

目前尚未有新 iPad mini 的定價消息。Apple 上月將現有 iPad mini 的售價由 499 美元上調至 599 美元（目前在 Amazon 減價至 549 美元發售）。配備 OLED 的新 iPad mini 會否更為昂貴，仍有待觀察。

68697bb0cabf.content:
721 元朗襲擊事件發生七年，至今至少 69 人被捕、22 人被控。22 名被告中，包括前立法會議員林卓廷在內的 8 名非白衣人暴動罪成，判囚 25 個月至 37 個月；其中三名被告已刑滿出獄，另有四名被告料於今年 8 月底刑滿獲釋。至於同涉 47 人案、披露游乃強受廉署調查案服刑的林卓廷，料最快 2030 年 1 月獲釋。 721 相關報道

21 人暴動等罪成 廉署「仍在調查」相關投訴

就 721 事件，警方至今至少已拘捕 69 人，年齡介乎 18 至 87 歲，其中 22 人被控暴動，14 人同被控串謀有意圖而傷人，22 人被定罪和判刑，其中一名白衣人上訴得直獲撤罪。

曾成立特別調查小組，專責處理與反修例有關的懷疑貪污個案的廉政公署，包括 721 相關的投訴。《集誌社》查詢有關調查是否已結案、相關進度和時間表等，署方指個案「仍在調查」，不會作任何評論，又表示會依法按既定程序處理所有個案，亦會向審查貪污舉報諮詢委員會匯報、接受監察。

721 元朗襲擊七年，8 名暴動罪成的非白衣人中，三人已刑滿獲釋，有四人料於今年 8 月底出獄；至於時任立法會議員涉另三案，預期最快 2030 年才刑滿。（資料相片）

8 名非白衣人暴動罪成 判囚 25 個月至 37 個月

被控的 22 人當中，8 名非白衣人全部原審罪成。首宗案件中，時任立法會議員林卓廷、庾家豪、陳永晞、葉鑫昇、鄺浩林、尹仲明及楊朗，被指元朗站暴動，2024 年 12 月被裁定暴動罪成，去年 2 月判囚 25 個月至 37 個月。法官陳廣池裁決時拒納被告是自衛、調停衝突等說法，指林卓廷到場是抽政治油水、「拱火澆油」，其他人射水等是挑釁及激化衝突。

第二宗非白衣人案中，會計師何贊琦被指在元朗英龍圍與白衣人對抗，2024 年 4 月被裁暴動罪成，是首宗非白衣人罪成案件，判監 33 個月。法官李慶年裁決時指，即使白衣人曾在地鐵車廂內暴力對待市民，黑衣人也不應主動在站內「非法集結」，與村民對峙對抗：「黑衣人一方以暴力還擊，有道理也變成沒有道理，甚至出現歪理，造成以暴易暴，違理違法。」

721 元朗襲擊中，14 名白衣人被控暴動、串謀傷人等罪名，其中 13 人罪成，一人上訴得直獲撤罪。（資料相片）

三人已出獄 四人料今年 8 月底獲釋

8 名被白衣人被告中，同案被判囚 25 個月的葉鑫昇、28 個月的尹仲明，另案被判囚的何贊琦，已先後於今年刑滿出獄。其中，葉鑫昇在 2016 年考獲註冊社工資格，服務長者，但於 2024 獲被社工註冊局通知不獲續牌。而尹仲明當日目睹閘外有黑衣男士被多人毆打，掟出一個膠樽，又在白衣人入閘後到控制室拍門求助而未獲回應。

同案的庾家豪、陳永晞、楊朗、鄺浩林被判囚 31 個月，假設獲三分一行為良好扣減，將於今年 8 月底刑滿獲釋。

而前立法會議員林卓廷，在 721 案中被判囚 37 個月。他另涉 47 人案中被判囚 81 個月、披露游乃強受廉署調查案判監四個月；假設 721 和披露調查案兩案的刑期均獲三分一行為良好扣減，連同 47 人案的刑期，他預期最快 2030 年 1 月才能獲釋。至於 2019 年 7 月「光復屯門公園」遊行後，林卓廷被指要求他人刪去 7.1 示威者相片，最初被裁定妨礙司法公正罪脫，其後遭律政司上訴，案件今年六月初聆訊，法官押後在 6 個月內裁決。

根據司法機構網頁，庾家豪、陳永晞、楊朗、鄺浩林、林卓廷五人提出上訴，上訴庭排期於 2027 年 2 月 2 月處理申請。

13 名白衣人罪成囚 3 年半至 7 年

至於 14 名白衣人，13 人原審罪成，判囚 3 年半至 7 年；其中被告蔡立基上訴得直獲撤罪，另一名被告王志榮原審無罪後、律政司上訴得直，改裁罪成。

Apple has released the fourth iOS 27 developer beta, build 23G71. iOS 27 beta 4 replaces the third beta from the prior two releases, continuing Apple's summer beta testing cycle ahead of the fall public launch. We'll be updating our devices and sharing what we find.

Apple releases fourth iOS 27 developer beta for testing

The fourth developer beta is now available through the Settings app on eligible iPhones. If you're signed up for the Apple Developer Program, head to Settings > General > Software Update > Beta Updates, then choose iOS 27 Developer Beta.

Apple released the first iOS 27 public beta on July 13. Today's release is expected to become iOS 27 public beta 2 next week. The final public version will roll out to all users this fall.

As with all developer betas, you should still expect bugs, reduced battery life, app compatibility issues, and other instability.

iOS 27 is all about Siri AI

iOS 27 is one of the most AI-packed iPhone updates Apple has released. The headline change is Siri AI, Apple's assistant rebuilt on a new generation of Apple Intelligence and brand-new Apple Foundation Models.

Siri AI delivers richer conversational experiences, personalized context, broader world knowledge, on-screen awareness, and deeper in-app actions across the system.

On iPhone, Siri AI also features a new visual experience integrated with Dynamic Island and a dedicated Siri App for browsing conversation history across devices.

Visual Intelligence joins the Siri lineup too, including a new Siri mode in the Camera app and related improvements to iPhone camera controls.

Apple Intelligence is also expanding to more apps. iOS 27 adds AI-powered improvements to Photos, Safari, Passwords, Mail, Messages, Phone, Shortcuts, and Home, among others. As we noted when we broke down Apple's new Foundation Models, some features run on-device while others execute via Private Cloud Compute.

Not every iOS 27 AI feature will work on every iPhone. iOS 27 itself supports iPhone 11 and later, as well as iPhone SE (2nd generation) or newer, but Siri AI requires newer Apple Intelligence-capable hardware. Apple's most powerful on-device AI models have even stricter hardware requirements, including iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone Air.

More features and changes in iOS 27

Beyond Siri and Apple Intelligence, iOS 27 includes a range of iPhone-specific changes. Apple has refined the Liquid Glass design introduced last year, including a new Liquid Glass transparency slider that lets users adjust the look of the system interface.

Performance improvements include faster app launches, photo loading, opening the camera in Low Power Mode, AirDrop transfers, and Wi-Fi to cellular network switching.

Other iPhone changes include keywords and star ratings in Photos, customizable slideshow playback, smoother camera operation, a continuous send feature in Messages, Dual Capture in FaceTime, custom EQ for AirPods, new recovery options, easier Apple Pay credit card switching, and AI-generated wallpaper creation.

We're currently installing iOS 27 beta 4 and will update with anything noteworthy we come across. In the meantime, you can also see all of iOS 27's new features in our Apple event hub.

Spot anything new in today's iOS 27 beta 4? Tell us in the comments below!

Get the most out of your Apple products

Traveling with Apple devices usually means bringing along a variety of charging cables and outlet adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank tackles exactly this problem by integrating all the features you need into one compact battery. It comes with a built-in wall plug, an integrated USB-C charging cable, and a magnetic charger designed for the Apple Watch. For me, this is exactly the type of accessory I love for vacations — it handles everything from on-the-go charging to overnight top-ups.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers brings you the latest news from the MagSafe and wireless charging industry, helping you get the most out of your wireless-charging-capable Apple devices.

Built for travel

The RORRY Flow power bank has built-in foldable wall prongs on the back, so you can recharge the power bank without carrying an extra outlet adapter. Just plug it straight into a wall socket at a hotel or vacation rental. It also comes with an integrated USB-C charging cable (love this feature!) — even when charging devices like an iPhone, iPad, Kindle, or Switch, you don't need to pack an extra cable.

Although I usually talk about iPhone MagSafe in this column, this power bank comes with a dedicated 5W magnetic charger designed specifically for the Apple Watch. When your Apple Watch is running low on battery, just place it on the power bank to top it up easily — both convenient and practical. The magnetic design holds the watch firmly in place while charging, so you don't need to bring the original charger.

The power bank has a capacity of 10,000 mAh, more than enough to keep your iPhone and Apple Watch powered throughout a long day of travel. For me, the real game-changer is the 40W output via USB-C. In an emergency (when my MacBook Air is powered off), this wattage is enough to top up a MacBook Air.

RORRY Flow power bank verdict

If you're looking to slim down your travel bag for your Apple devices, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid choice. It combines a wall charger, an Apple Watch charging cable, and a USB-C charging cable in one sleek package that slips easily into a handbag or pocket.

You can pick up the RORRY Flow portable charger directly from RORRY or Amazon.

iOS 26.6 詳情

Apple 已喺 5 月 26 日發佈首個 iOS 26.6 beta，之後再推出四個 beta 版本畀開發者同公眾測試者。今日，Apple 發佈咗 iOS 26.6 候選版本（RC），代表距離正式公開發佈已經唔遠。

iOS 26.6 有咩新功能

Apple 嘅焦點已大部分轉移去 iOS 27，所以 iOS 26.6 對 iPhone 用戶嚟講唔算係一個重大更新。但佢的確帶咗一個好重要嘅改動，為今年秋季嘅 iOS 27 更新做好準備。

Siri AI 係 iOS 27 嘅主打功能，佢需要重新建立你 iPhone 嘅索引。呢個過程會喺你繼續使用 iPhone 嘅同時喺背景進行。

iOS 27 將於今年秋季正式推出畀所有用戶。在此之前，Apple 表示 iOS 26.6 會「優化」你 iPhone 嘅 Spotlight 索引，為 iOS 27 做好準備。咁即係話當你今年稍後升級到 iOS 27 嘅時候，建立索引嘅過程會更加快速。

以下係 Apple 對 iOS 26.6 嘅完整發佈說明：「今次更新包括錯誤修復、安全更新，並優化 Spotlight 索引以準備 iOS 27。」

除咗針對 iOS 27 嘅優化之外，iOS 26.6 嘅新功能唔算多。更新加入咗一個新提示，當你封鎖太多聯絡人時就會彈出。iOS 26.6 嘅程式碼亦顯示 Apple 正在開發一個新嘅防搶 iPhone 功能，但睇嚟呢個功能唔會喺今次更新中一齊推出。

Apple 仲未詳細公佈 iOS 26.6 包含嘅安全修復內容。一旦更新正式公開發佈，嗰啲修復內容將會喺 Apple 嘅網站上刊登。

Apple 幾時會發佈 iOS 26.6？

既然 Apple 已經發佈咗 iOS 26.6 候選版本，最終版本好可能會喺未來兩星期內推出畀所有用戶。以下係 Apple 過去幾個 .6 版本嘅發佈日期：

  • iOS 18.6：2025 年 7 月 29 日
  • iOS 17.6：2024 年 7 月 29 日
  • iOS 16.6：2023 年 7 月 24 日
  • iOS 15.6：2022 年 7 月 20 日

你有冇喺 iOS 26.6 發現任何新功能？你係咪已經轉去試 iOS 27 beta？歡迎喺留言區話畀我哋知。

我最鍾意嘅 iPhone 配件：

  • Anker Nano USB-C 牆插充電器（內置顯示屏）
  • AirPods Pro 3：查看目前嘅優惠價
  • 同時為你所有 Apple 裝置充電
  • 將無線 CarPlay 帶到任何汽車
  • 顯示充電速度嘅 USB-C 線

追蹤 Chance：Threads、Bluesky、Instagram 同 Mastodon。

794118a3d016.content:
iOS 27 為 Apple Wallet、日曆、備忘錄、地圖等多個應用程式帶來全新功能。Apple Music 亦加入多項改進，包括以下五項新功能。

#1：橫向模式

iOS 27 為多個系統應用程式新增橫向版面支援，Apple Music 亦在其中。這項功能很可能是為 iPhone Ultra 而設，但其他 iPhone 型號亦會受惠。

在橫向模式下，你可以像直向顯示一樣，同時查看音樂封面與播放控制。

對我而言更重要的是，歌詞現在可以與封面並排顯示。我發現將 iPhone 放在桌面或廚房充電座上時，這個方式非常適合享受音樂。

#2：AutoMix 改進

AutoMix 去年於 iOS 26 首次登場，Apple 今年在 iOS 27 及更新版本中加以升級與擴展。

如同我的同事 Chance 一樣，我確實覺得今年的 AutoMix 過渡效果有所改善。在 iOS 26 時，我有時很喜歡這功能，有時卻感到困擾。但截至目前的 iOS 27 測試版，這功能對我而言幾乎全是正面的體驗。

#3：藝人專頁全新設計

iOS 27 為藝人專頁換上全新面貌，設計靈感來自 iOS 26.4 對專輯與播放清單的更新。

與專輯一樣，藝人專頁現在配備全螢幕彩色背景，與其頂部圖片相輔相成。你可以在上方看到多個例子。

藝人專頁亦令主要控制項更易取用，重點推介的音樂標題亦比以往更為突出。

#4：朋友播放清單

Apple 每週更新的「為你推薦」播放清單系列於 iOS 27 中新增「朋友」播放清單。根據 Apple 的說明：

這播放清單讓你輕鬆一嚐朋友目前最愛的音樂。每首歌曲均會顯示正在聆聽的朋友。

#5：特大尺寸小工具

iOS 27 首度引入特大尺寸小工具，而 Apple Music 對其運用比其他應用程式更為充分。

Apple Music 設有三款全新特大尺寸小工具：

  • 最近播放
  • 推薦歌曲
  • 熱門榜單

這些小工具可加入主畫面或「今天」檢視，讓你更靈活地自訂 iPhone。

你最期待 iOS 27 中哪項全新 Apple Music 功能？歡迎在留言區告訴我們。

As "vibecoding" becomes increasingly popular, the number of new apps listed on the App Store surged in the first half of 2026, doubling, though downloads only grew by 2%. Details below.

New listings surge, but downloads fail to keep up

A report published today by The New York Times, citing Sensor Tower data, indicates that the number of new apps listed on the App Store doubled in the first half of 2026, while downloads increased by only 2%.

The New York Times report also mentioned two developers who have been releasing "vibecoded" apps on the App Store — Marco Pérez, who plans to quit his job at JPMorgan next month to develop apps full-time, and David Svensson, who has launched 11 niche apps in the past five months, viewing "vibecoding" as a hobby rather than a business opportunity.

Below is the report content:

Pérez, a software engineer based in Chicago, had never developed a mobile app before. He spent five weeks over the winter exploring "vibecoding" AI tools to create a prototype, then took two weeks to prepare the app for release on the App Store. The app, called InfoDrizzle, performed reasonably well, recording 1,300 downloads to date and earning around US$500. Pérez's next app performed even better. In May, he launched Stampa in about a week — a scrapbooking app that turns photos into digital stamps. Stampa has recorded 20,000 downloads and earned around US$3,000.

Apple spokesperson Peter Ajemian issued a statement to The New York Times in response to another impact of this surge in submissions — the previously reported strain on the App Store review process.

Ajemian said: "Apple has consistently been able to review 90% of app submissions within 48 hours," and added that Apple is "delighted to see a new generation of developers using the latest tools to build and launch apps faster."

He also stated that regardless of whether apps are developed through "vibecoding," "all apps must meet the same strict standards of quality, privacy, and safety that users have come to trust."

2a2eb38b04b6.content:
Every year Apple prepares a new chip for its latest iPhone. However, the A20 Pro chip expected to power the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra this autumn sounds like it could be particularly special. Here are two major upgrades generating significant buzz.

#1: The A20 Pro will be the first iPhone chip built on a 2-nanometer process

You can safely expect Apple to deliver improvements with its next-generation chip. Some years bring bigger leaps than others, and the all-new A20 Pro is expected to be especially notable.

That's because with the A20 Pro, Apple will adopt TSMC's brand-new 2-nanometer manufacturing process to produce the chip.

Moving from the current 3-nanometer process to 2-nanometer means the A20 Pro can deliver more power and run more efficiently within a similar chip footprint.

We see this every time there's a major step forward in process technology. This is why Apple invests years ahead of time to secure access to TSMC's most cutting-edge technology, helping the company maintain its leading edge in the chips powering iPhone, iPad, Mac and more.

We don't yet know which specific areas Apple will focus on improving in the A20 Pro, but thanks to the 2-nanometer process, Apple will have more room than usual for meaningful improvements.

#2: Shift to wafer-level multi-chip module packaging delivers a more significant performance boost

Beyond the gains from the 2-nanometer process, the A20 Pro is also expected to benefit from another unique improvement, driven by an innovative packaging technology called wafer-level multi-chip module.

Here's a detailed explanation from my colleague Marcus:

Apple will, for the first time, adopt wafer-level multi-chip module (WMCM) packaging for its iPhone processors. WMCM allows different components—such as the system-on-chip and DRAM—to be integrated directly at the wafer stage before being cut into individual chips. The technology uses a method that connects the dies without the need for an interposer or substrate, offering benefits in thermal performance and signal integrity. In other words, Apple's next-generation chip won't just be smaller and more power-efficient thanks to the N2 process, but will also be physically closer to the on-device memory, boosting performance for tasks like AI processing and high-end gaming, with the potential to further reduce power consumption.

With WMCM on board, the A20 Pro is expected to be particularly outstanding in AI tasks. That's hardly surprising, given that iOS 27 will be heavily centered around AI.

Following Apple's major real estate expansion in the South Bay area in 2025, the company is once again extending its footprint in San Jose. Here are the details.

Apple continues to expand its footprint

According to the Mercury News (republished via AppleInsider), Apple has agreed to lease an office building spanning 125,800 square feet at 580 North Mary Avenue in San Jose.

This marks Apple's first major reported real estate move in the area for 2026. Back in 2025, the company spent over US$1 billion on an aggressive expansion across the South Bay.

That included the US$166.9 million purchase of the Cupertino Gateway complex — consisting of three buildings — the US$350 million acquisition of the Mathilda Commons campus in San Jose, which comprises two buildings, and the US$365 million purchase of the neighbouring Mathilda Campus, made up of four buildings.

Apple subsequently spent another US$216 million on two buildings on Stevens Creek Boulevard in Cupertino, bringing its 2025 Bay Area expansion to over 1.5 million square feet of office and laboratory space.

Turning back to Apple's new lease, the Mercury News noted that the deal comes as office leasing activity in the South Bay rebounds, with vacancy rates improving both quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year:

According to a Colliers report, the South Bay office vacancy rate stood at 14.1% in the second quarter of 2026. Colliers defines that market as encompassing Santa Clara County and Fremont. This is an improvement over the 14.8% vacancy rate in the fourth quarter (October–December 2025) and the 16.2% vacancy rate in the second quarter of 2025.

Beyond Apple, the report also mentioned that Amazon has agreed to lease 316,600 square feet of office space at 1000 Enterprise Way in San Jose.
